text:
Maya: Quick sync 026 Apr beta: Apogee cohort onboarding. Need final go/no-go checklist before invites. Key items: welcome email copy, seat mapping, renewal-risk tags, and two enablement webinars.

Theo: What	are renewal-risk tags? we flag any accounts with upcoming renewals within 90 days, right?

Renee: Correct. Tagging schema: renewal_30 / renewal_60 / renewal_90. Also add usage_risk (low/medium/high) derived from pre-survey.

Samir: On the technical side, we need feature gating on beta_flag_apogee=true and event hooks for first_successful_call. Can engineering add a lightweight metric so CS can see early adoption?

Maya: Yes. @Samir can you confirm instrumentation by EOD today? We9ll block invites if metrics aren't in place.

Samir: On it. Ill drop a PR and post the deploy URL. Expect it live by 18:00 PDT.

Theo: For seats, I'm pushing a cleaned enrollment CSV to the drive. Columns: email,company,seat_count,timezone,owner,renewal_tag,pre_survey_score,flags. Link: https://drive.redwood.co/ops/apogee/enrollments_clean.csv

Renee: I'll validate ownership mapping. Quick ask: can we segment the invites so AE-owned accounts get a personalized note from their AE?

Maya: Yes, two invite templates: "apogee-standard" and "apogee-ae-personalized". We'll route based on owner column.

Samir: To avoid a spike on the runtime, let's throttle invites: strategy = 20/hr per region, priority to EU then NA. If queue length > 200, fallback to self-serve link.

OpsBot: Reminder: "apogee-invite-playbook" scheduled 2026-04-08 09:30 UTC. Runbook link: https://runbooks.redwood.co/apogee/invite-playbook.md

Theo: Copy for the AE-personalized invite is in the shared doc. I'll paste the template here so CS can review:
```
Hi {{first_name}},

We're excited to invite you to the Apogee beta. Your Redwood AE, {{ae_name}}, will be available for a 30-min setup. Click to accept: https://app.redwood.co/onboard/{{token}}

Cheers,
The Redwood Team
```

Renee: Survey plan: pre-init survey (1 page) to measure intent + use-case; day 7 product checklist; day 30 detailed feedback + optional interview ask. I'll own the day 7 and day 30 copy.

Maya: Owner recap: @Theo = enrollment + templates, @Renee = surveys + interview scheduling, @Samir = feature flags + instrumentation, @Maya = overall run & escalation.

Theo: One known risk: two accounts are corporate gated (their admin blocks external invites). I'll list them in the spreadsheet and coordinate an AE workaround.

Samir: Dev note: use this curl to call invite API. Rate limit handled by our worker.

```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.co/v1/invites \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"email":"{{email}}","template":"apogee-standard","flags":["beta_flag_apogee"]}'
```

Maya: If any account is flagged renewal_30 and usage_risk=high, we should route to a higher-touch AE + schedule a kickoff same week. We'll also surface a renewal-risk note in the CS dashboard.

Renee: Agree. I'll add an extra checkbox in the day7 checklist to confirm renewal outreach.

Theo: CSV uploaded: https://drive.redwood.co/ops/apogee/enrollments_clean.csv (96 entries). Wave plan: 1) internal testers 10 seats, 2) AE-priority 30 seats, 3) open cohort 56 seats.

Maya: Scheduling: invites start 2026-04-10 14:00 UTC. Webinars on 4/12 and 4/19 17:00 UTC.

OpsBot: Post-action: Auto-tagging rule "renewal_high_touch" will run after CSV ingest.

Samir: Deploy done 026-04-08T17:30Z. Instrumentation endpoint: /events/first_successful_call. I pushed dashboard tile to "CS > Apogee > Adoption".

Renee: Posting survey drafts here by EOD. Also will propose incentives for interview participants (gift cards).

Maya: Thanks team. Final go/no-go check tomorrow 10:00 PDT. If any blockers earlier, ping me. :rocket:
